panels.label: Dorki — 2026-09-20 final Season 2 Mythic+ tier list (tank placements)
panels.creator: Dorki
panels.scopeNote: Live Season 2 Mythic+ after the announced September 22 tuning ("the final announced tuning"); a full-roster list built on Wowhead Tiercraft, captured here only for the six tank specs inside his registered scope. His tiers split S and A each into a raid-buffs and a "natty strong" (raw power) half, which carry the same letter; the F tier he calls realistically a B.

rows.context: Season 2 live — Mythic+ tier list, creator's own placement
rows.text: Spoken as "natty strong" — his shorthand for the S natty-strong tier (he reserves "A natty strong" for the A tier, e.g. Arms, Protection Paladin) — and "still one of the best tanks if not the best".

rows.context: Season 2 live — Mythic+ tier list, creator's own placement
rows.text: "I had this at S tier, but I'm not entirely sold on Vengeance anymore" — moved down on screen; the destination letter is never spoken.
rows.reason: Demoted from S on screen without a spoken destination tier.
